content:
Visitors can follow three journeys, leave notes, and suggest missing places.
The team will use the quiet feedback station prepared in
[Prepare the Atlas open studio](/note/tasks/prepare_open_studio).

occurrences.context: - Reviewing research on third places with Jamie - Preparing the Atlas open studio - Turning observations from the field day into stories
- Test the prototype at the open studio.
- A public prototype shaped by clear design principles - A reusable conversation kit - A small collection of place stories informed by research - An open review at the Atlas open studio
It may reuse the icon language from the Atlas after the open studio review.
